mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.15% indicates near-zero monetary policy accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.15% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0 percentage points signals labor market distress that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 13000) and unemployment surge (UNRATE > 5.0) indicate severe economic contraction, triggering negative equity returns due to reduced corporate profitability and risk aversion over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 13000 and UNRATE > 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recovery, rising housing starts (HOUST > 500) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS > 300000) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during the early-cycle recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 220 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates sustained manufacturing expansion, reducing recession risk and supporting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 100 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 130000) and stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 0.2) signal strong labor market conditions with accommodative finance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary ease
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST > 500) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS > 300000) signal economic overheating, triggering negative S&P 500 returns due to anticipated monetary tightening over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during the late-cycle expansion regime.
